author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be a Chinese version of me, with some of the best voice cloning and dubbing I've seen. This is not a new thing entirely but the quality of it surpasses even what I've seen YouTube do when it tries presenting videos to countries I don't target. How is it so good? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: They Made A Chinese Mutahar...
